definitions.explanation: The final period of the calendar year, typically referring to December and the days leading up to New Year's.

examples.japanese: {年末|ねんまつ}は{忙|いそが}しい。
examples.english: The end of the year is busy.

examples.japanese: {年末|ねんまつ}のセールで{買|か}い{物|もの}をした。
examples.english: I went shopping at the year-end sale.

examples.japanese: {年末|ねんまつ}になると{大掃除|おおそうじ}をするのが{日本|にほん}の{習慣|しゅうかん}だ。
examples.english: Doing a big cleaning at year-end is a Japanese custom.

notes:
USAGE:
Often paired with {年始|ねんし} (beginning of the year) in the compound {年末年始|ねんまつねんし}, which refers to the holiday period spanning late December through early January.

CULTURAL NOTE:
{年末|ねんまつ} is associated with {大掃除|おおそうじ} (year-end cleaning), {忘年会|ぼうねんかい} (year-end parties), and preparations for {正月|しょうがつ} (New Year). Many businesses close during {年末年始|ねんまつねんし}.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {年末|ねんまつ}セール: year-end sale
- {年末|ねんまつ}{調整|ちょうせい}: year-end adjustment (tax)
- {年末年始|ねんまつねんし}: year-end and New Year period
- {年末|ねんまつ}{商戦|しょうせん}: year-end sales competition
